quarterly_data.quarter: Global Communication Semiconductors MOPS monthly revenue: September 2026 (10-10-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: September 2026 monthly revenue (MOPS filing): consolidated net revenue NT$435,025 thousand (US$13,715 thousand in its functional currency) versus NT$204,290 thousand in September 2025 (+112.94% YoY in NT$; +103.88% in US$); January-September 2026 NT$2,329,395 thousand (US$73,390 thousand), +54.61% YoY in NT$ (+52.08% in US$). Filed reason for the month: customer demand for the company's own optoelectronic component products kept growing, substrate supply was stable and wafer-foundry order demand stayed steady, so the month's sales were up 113% versus the same period last year. Filed reason for the year to date: continuing last year's trend, demand from AI data-center customers for its own optoelectronic component products kept growing, substrate supply was stable and wafer-foundry order demand also stayed steady, so cumulative sales were up 55% versus last year.
